🥑 When to plant avocado in Nigeria

Quick answer: Plant avocado in Nigeria from June to July and harvest from May to September. Planted in the rains; the main fruit season is in the middle of the year.

PlantJune to July
HarvestMay to September
Grows inNorth-Central, South-West, South-South, North-East and North-West
TypeFruits
JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec

■ plant   ■ harvest

About avocado

Grafted avocado trees fruit in about 3–4 years; seedlings take longer.

How to plant avocado well

Avocado ripens after picking. Leave it to soften at room temperature.

Planted in the rains; the main fruit season is in the middle of the year.

Diseases and pests of avocado

  • Phytophthora root rotPlant on well-drained soil.
  • AnthracnoseHarvest carefully and avoid bruising.

🩺 Something wrong with your avocado? Ask the Farm Doctor

Best states for avocado

Plateau · Kaduna · Cross River · Ogun · Oyo · Taraba · Benue

Questions farmers ask

When is the best time to plant avocado in Nigeria?

Plant avocado in Nigeria from June to July and harvest from May to September. Planted in the rains; the main fruit season is in the middle of the year.

When is avocado harvested in Nigeria?

Avocado is usually harvested from May to September.

Which Nigerian states grow the most avocado?

Plateau, Kaduna, Cross River, Ogun, Oyo, Taraba and Benue are among the best-known avocado states.

Can I grow avocado in my part of Nigeria?

Avocado grows best in the North-Central, South-West, South-South, North-East and North-West regions. In other regions, ask your ADP extension officer before planting.

What diseases attack avocado and how do I prevent them?

Phytophthora root rot: Plant on well-drained soil. Anthracnose: Harvest carefully and avoid bruising.
